verdict.rationale: Interview self-scheduling is a fair axis for an applicant tracking system like Workable, but the evidence pack never mentions calendar integration, live availability, booking links, or candidate self-scheduling. The 'interview-ready shortlist' line (workable-docs-15) is about sourcing and screening, not scheduling, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a recruiter, candidates self-schedule from live calendar availability — booking links tied to my team's calendars end the timezone email chains
